HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Technology Assignment Agreement, June 7, 2011
Jane Doe assigns to Harbor Labs, Inc. all of her right, title and interest in the
KitchenGrid software, designs, customer research, trade name and marks.
The assignment is made in exchange for the 613,240 shares sold to her under the
Stock Agreement.
She agrees to sign what the company reasonably asks for to record this assignment.
She holds the domain kitchengrid.example and will move it to the company on request.
Signed: Jane Doe. Accepted for the company: Richard Roe, Chief Technology Officer.
